title: Fix the operator docs the credential split left stale
description:
FROM THE n3q REVIEW, and the reason it matters is that following these docs by hand now SILENTLY DOES NOTHING.

docs/factory-credentials.md still tells an operator the local mirror is ~/.ticksrc (around lines 19, 49, 58-61, 162) and instructs anyone wanting to drop the local copy to 'delete the factory_github_token and factory_gateway_key lines from ~/.ticksrc'. Post-split that file does not hold those keys, so an operator who follows the instruction believes they have removed a credential and has not. That is worse than an out-of-date doc — it is a doc that produces a false belief about where a secret lives.

repo-wiki/credential-split.md already tracks the full stale set, explicitly deferred here by the elt design: docs/factory-credentials.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/design/cloud-factory.md, cloud/factory/README.md, cloud/DOMAIN_SETUP.md, skills/ticks/references/tk-commands.md.

PRIORITISE BY HARM, not by file order. factory-credentials.md is the one that can leave a real credential in place while telling someone it is gone; the rest are ordinary staleness. Do that one properly and correctly rather than sweeping all seven quickly.

DO THIS BEFORE PHASE 5. The move relocates these files, and relocating a wrong doc makes it someone else's wrong doc in a new repo.
notes: 2026-09-02 13:34 - Closed 2026-09-02 as legacy (Peter: no cycles on the old world). Superseded by project hzm (ticfac). The decoupling this project did stands and is built on by hzm Phase 1/2; the remaining move and cutover are hzm Phases 1, 4 and 7.
acceptance_criteria: docs/factory-credentials.md describes the post-split reality, and its remove-the-local-copy instruction actually removes the credential it claims to. The other six files in repo-wiki/credential-split.md's stale list are corrected or explicitly deferred with a reason. No instruction anywhere tells an operator to edit a file that no longer holds the key named.
